**fuzzel** is a fast application launcher for the iosc Wayland compositor.

Using the wlr layer-shell protocol, fuzzel appears as an overlay, filters your applications as you type, and launches the one you pick.

- Native Wayland launcher via the wlr layer-shell protocol
- Fuzzy matching with instant filtering
- Reads desktop entries and shows their icons
- fcft text rendering for crisp labels

Launch it inside an Xios desktop session running the iosc compositor.

[More screenshots and port details](https://xios.maxleiter.com/apps/fuzzel)
